title: Multicompartmentalized microreactors based on Pickering emulsions for continuous-flow oxidation of primary benzylic alcohols
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46664-46673
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05598A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yixuan He
The first use of palladium-loaded silica nanospheres as emulsifiers for Pickering emulsions enabling green oxidation of benzylic alcohols is described. The approach eliminates toxic waste generation and is suitable for continuous flow oxidation.
